Connor / Aditya — reviewed the GF questionnaire and your draft Exhibit A. High-level comments below; I also added tracked-change suggestions in the attached PDF.

1) IP / Outputs (Section 4.2):
- Proposed position: Customer owns customer data and the direct outputs it provides to them (configurations, user-provided assets). Redwood retains ownership of model weights, pre-trained artifacts, and service improvements. Recommend "limited rights" language for derivative outputs: customer has perpetual, non-exclusive rights to use outputs for internal business purposes, with restrictions on re-distribution of models.

2) Indemnity (Section 6):
- We will indemnify for third-party IP infringement claims arising from Redwood-provided software as delivered. We need carve-outs for (a) customer-provided data that causes the claim, (b) combination with non-Redwood systems where the claim would not have arisen, and (c) modifications by customer or third parties.

3) Liability Cap (Section 8):
- Standard company play: cap liability at the greater of (i) 12 months of fees paid under the order form and (ii) $5,000,000, with exceptions for willful misconduct and breach of data security obligations (including regulatory fines).
- If Greenfield insists on a lower cap, suggest trade: 6 months of fees + increased cyber insurance requirement and stronger SLA credits.

4) Order Form and Billing:
- We accept DocuSign. For new enterprise terms, standard net-30. If procurement requires net-45, finance can approve for GF as a one-time concession in exchange for a 12-month commit and any prepayment milestone.

Please see attached annotated Exhibit A. Marissa — if we move to a concession on cap (e.g., 6 months), what's the recommended commercial offset (credit, commit, or insurance)?

Laura Bennett
Head of Legal | Redwood Inference

Quick commercial note:
- If Greenfield requests a cap below 12 months, typical offsets we seek are one or a combination of: (a) 12-month minimum commitment, (b) an increased annual subscription prepayment, or (c) broadened indemnity for third-party claims tied to Redwood platform.
- For this deal (estimated ACV $780k), recommended counter: 9 months of fees cap + 6-month prepayment on signature OR require industry-standard cyber insurance ($5M) naming Redwood as additional insured.

Connor — happy to draft a short commercial memo to send with the updated Exhibit to help procurement present to their CFO.

Marissa Cole

Connor / team — thanks for the quick turnaround. Greenfield Legal reviewed your annotated Exhibit A and provided two comments:

1) They would prefer the liability cap to be expressed as a specific dollar amount instead of a multiple-of-fees. Their initial counter: $3,000,000 cap with standard carve-outs.
2) For IP outputs, they want explicit language that allows Greenfield to use outputs for commercial internal and external purposes (i.e., not limited strictly to internal use).

We have a short internal session this afternoon and will aim to come back with a consolidated position by EOD. CFO wants a simple comparison (Redwood's ask vs GF counter) — could you send a two-line summary for each item so we can bake into the procurement deck?

Sofia — thanks. Below are the two-line comparisons for the CFO slide deck. Happy to join the call if that helps.

IP / Outputs
- Redwood position: Customer owns customer-provided data and derived outputs for internal business use; Redwood retains model weights and improvements.
- GF counter: Customer requests rights to use outputs for external commercial purposes; tolerable with a limited license grant if accompanied by usage-based pricing and redistribution restrictions.

Liability Cap
- Redwood position: Greater of 12 months of fees (~$780k) or $5,000,000; carve-outs for willful misconduct and breaches.
- GF counter: Fixed $3,000,000 cap with carve-outs; ask is reasonable — willing to meet them at 3M if Greenfield agrees to a 12-month commit and $1M cyber insurance naming Redwood.

Order Form / Billing
- Redwood: DocuSign OK; net-30 standard.
- GF: Net-45 requested; offer: net-45 for first year if 12-month commit + invoice prepayment for month one.

Next steps: I will send the updated Exhibit A with a short commercial memo attached and propose a call Friday at 10am PT to finalize.

Connor O'Brien
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
